text:
karen: spotted a KMS-wrapped blob in a partner debug bundle we pulled. blob id: PARTNER_BLOB_77a. not pasting blob. looks like it references projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/partner-ring/cryptoKeys/ingest-main. can we triage and plan rotation?
diego: thx. first step: enumerate who can decrypt that key. i'll run get-iam-policy and grep for service accounts.
yuki: agree. also create a short-lived Vault transit key to handle rewraps so we don't cause downtime. ops, can you prep that?
ops-oncall: i can create a transit key and a runbook checklist. target window tonight at 00:30 UTC for rewrap canary. need security sign-off.
security-bot: :rotating_light: Incident INC-3160 created (potential secret exposure). Assigned eng-security.
diego: preflight commands:```bash
gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy ingest-main --keyring=partner-ring --location=global --project=redwood-prod
gcloud kms keys versions list --key=ingest-main --keyring=partner-ring --location=global --project=redwood-prod
# local grep for other blob ids in archive
zgrep -o "PARTNER_BLOB_[0-9a-f]+" /tmp/partner_bundle/* | sort | uniq -c
```will paste counts.
yuki: RBAC proposal: remove groups and broad roles from that key, grant roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter only to serviceAccount:partner-ingest-sa@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com and to a short-lived rewrap-sa with a 24h expiration.
karen: i've alerted partner ops with minimal wording and asked them to rotate any credentials they might have pushed to logs. legal copied.
ops-oncall: runbook draft: steps: 1) enable KMS admin audit logs & sink to bq/audit_logs, 2) create vault transit key partners-rewrap-temp, 3) run canary rewrap for 5 ciphertexts, 4) validate app decrypts, 5) merge RBAC PR, 6) rotate production key versions, 7) revoke old versions and publish post-rotation checklist.
diego: canary rewrap dry-run command i'll use:```bash
python infra/rewrap.py --dry-run --ciphertext PARTNER_BLOB_77a --from-key projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/partner-ring/cryptoKeys/ingest-main --to-key projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/partner-ring/cryptoKeys/ingest-main-v2
```will only log to secure runbook.
yuki: add abort criteria: if >5% of canary fails or any app errors surface, stop and rollback. also ensure Vault audit logs retention bumped to 180d for investigation window.
ops-oncall: creating audit sink now. will post confirmation in this thread in 10m.
security-bot: :memo: Checklist: [x] incident INC-3160 created, [ ] IAM enumeration, [ ] audit sink, [ ] transit key, [ ] canary rewrap, [ ] RBAC PR, [ ] full rotate, [ ] partner confirm.
karen: please keep updates short; runbook is canonical. adding runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/INC-3160-rotate
diego: found 4 blob ids in the archive tied to that key. posting minimal counts to runbook.
yuki: prepping RBAC PR now. tagging @security-review for expedited review.
ops-oncall: audit sink created and verified. logs flowing to bq.redwood_audit.kms with 90d retention.
diego: preflight also found one other key referenced in older logs; i'll include that in scope if present during rewrap.
karen: partner confirmed they'll take local action on their side. asking them to report back once done.
security-bot: :lock: Status update: preflight done, audit sink live. next: RBAC PR + canary window.
diego: starting dry-run rewrap in runbook. will report final canary status here.
yuki: remember to rotate any automation credentials that might be able to call cloudkms.decrypt. check CI runner service accounts.
ops-oncall: runbook updated with timestamps. will open pager if errors during canary.
karen: thanks, team. keep this thread for short updates only.
